kinds.title: Application base
kinds.description: The required workspace substrate every generated app is built on.

kinds.title: Frontend
kinds.description: The app's user interface. At most one may be selected.

kinds.title: Backends
kinds.description: Server-side runtimes: the HTTP API surface and the durable worker.

kinds.title: Databases
kinds.description: Backing data services a capability can depend on: persistence and object storage.

kinds.title: Features
kinds.description: The product capabilities an app can offer, each pulling in the runtimes and services it needs.

kinds.title: Deployment
kinds.description: Where the generated app runs, and the orchestration files that get it there.

capabilities.title: FastAPI
capabilities.description: The app's HTTP backend: a generic FastAPI application at apps/api with the file-based router and health routes. Feature capabilities register their routers into it.

capabilities.title: Workflows
capabilities.description: The app's durable worker: a uv project at apps/worker running the Temporal-backed workflow worker. It exposes no public port.

capabilities.title: Core
capabilities.description: Required application workspace shell: Bun and uv roots, NX project discovery, repeatable install and lock commands, and shared app-local settings, logging, telemetry, client, and command-line utilities.

capabilities.title: Postgres
capabilities.description: Postgres persistence: the first-boot extension script and the app-local db package (the async engine and session factory, the Alembic setup, and the models, accessors, and migrations directories that the feature capabilities owning each table fill in).

capabilities.title: Mistral Apps
capabilities.description: Deployment to the Mistral Apps platform. A gateway sits in front of the app and puts a short-lived token on every request, scoped to the person who made it. This capability supplies that token to `utils.mistral` as the credential a caller's work spends, so a route calling the Mistral API on someone's behalf is billed and authorised as them rather than against the app's own key. The hidden `apps-fastapi` integration mounts it on the FastAPI host. The platform builds and runs the app itself, so nothing here contributes orchestration files.

capabilities.title: Mistral Apps — API
capabilities.description: Mistral Apps × API integration. Mounts the gateway's caller token on the FastAPI host through `apps/api/src/api/configure/`, so a route that calls the Mistral API on someone's behalf spends their token. Hidden: it activates automatically when both `apps` and `fastapi` are effective, and selecting it directly is shorthand for that pair.

capabilities.title: FastAPI — Postgres
capabilities.description: Hidden FastAPI × Postgres integration carrying database health and shutdown hooks.

capabilities.title: FastAPI — TanStack Start
capabilities.description: FastAPI × TanStack Start integration. Owns the typed API client apps/web generates from the FastAPI OpenAPI contract (hey-api, under src/api/), its runtime base-URL config and the VITE_API_URL env schema. Hidden: it activates automatically when FastAPI and TanStack Start are both effective.

capabilities.title: FastAPI — Workflows
capabilities.description: Hidden FastAPI × workflows integration carrying API health metadata.

capabilities.title: Observability
capabilities.description: Send Mistral SDK and Workflow traces to Mistral Studio, with opt-in settings for code that reads Studio spans and evaluations, and agent guidance for instrumenting application-owned operations and tool calls.

capabilities.title: TanStack Start
capabilities.description: The app's frontend: a plain TanStack Start application at apps/web — file-based routes, TanStack Query, Tailwind, public packages only. Other capabilities add pages as route files.
